checks.expected: When not live, home personal direction, progress, learning summary and knowledge highlights must render from an empty personal state rather than cached personal data.
The knowledge page must show a signed-out state and must not render cached personal nodes or edges.
A trial renders only the current stage goal and one deliverable artifact.
No future stage cards are rendered before a result from the current artifact exists.
When the AI provider is not connected, the trial is explicitly a generic non-persistent skeleton and does not claim dynamic reasoning.

persistence_rule: Validation contract only; simulated personal outputs must not be persisted.
pass_rule: All required checks must pass before this frontend hardening artifact can be marked complete.
